HOT WATER

When your water heater needs attention

Changes in hot-water performance are useful information for a repair conversation.

Get a Free EstimateCall (619) 507-4947

Watch for a change in the pattern

Water that no longer reaches the usual temperature, a shorter supply of hot water, or a new sound can help explain the issue. Note when the change began and whether it affects every fixture.

Look at accessible connections

Visible moisture near the heater deserves attention. A connection problem and a tank problem can require different work, so avoid assuming the cause from a puddle alone.

Prepare for the estimate

Have the heater type, model if accessible, and a short description ready. Ask about repair and replacement options after the existing equipment is assessed.
